For a free-to-play title, Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra delivers an engaging, immersive experience that serves as a genuinely fun pastime. The core gameplay loop draws you in right away, and the regular addition of new characters keeps the roster fresh and exciting.

However, the game struggles over the long haul. The game modes quickly become repetitive, leading to a sense of monotony since every match ends up feeling like the exact same routine.

Another clear area for improvement is character balancing: newly released characters consistently arrive overtuned, instantly dominating the meta until the next update. If the developers can inject more variety into the game modes and rein in the post-launch power creep, it could become a truly great long-term game. Worth a try, but best enjoyed in short bursts.

I'm an avid MOBA fan, as with dragonball and when I heard that this game existed I really wanted to try and it play the game.

Well I have now and I'm a bit split. On one hand the game is fun, the gameplay itself is fun it feels like a moba. however there are some very very prominent issues with this game.

The MOBA Mechanics: They are very simple, 4 towers and the dragonball shell is all that exist in terms of a base. There no wards, but there is bushes and fog of war. There's no items just 3 perk cards which don't feel super impactful. There's a Helper system that also feels very unimpactful. in fact i forget to use them half the time and i still do well in fights

The Characters and balance of said characters: The characters that are available are cool they are pretty accurate to their designs from the show the issue is some of these characters are wildly unbalanced. 

For example the newest addition Gogeta can ult for every fight after he gets it and it causes you to become executable at nearly half HP. {executes are instant death upon taking damage past a certain threshold) and he has a very annoying hard to dodge stun/knock up that nearly guarantees the the half HP execute every single time.

This is an area effect as well so its not like you target one person and get get instantly executed you could do it to up to all 4 players on the enemy team even if that is unlikely. 

This is only the newest character there are a few others that are insanely overpowered.

The biggest issues: Because of the lack of wards and the ability to have vision control the game very quickly falls a part and just becomes a race of who can backdoor the towers and dragonball shell first. 4v3 team fights are no longer a game winning fight its a game losing fight because that 1 person who isnt in that fight is just backdooring the towers.

There's also a complete lack of minion waves and enemies can just do damage to your tower even if youre hitting them and canceling their gekishin bursts because even if they don't complete the charge up it still deals damage to the tower meaning you can just spam abilities on a low tower and it just dies there's no defending it as the defending team its just gone.

There's times where i should have won a game and lost all because the enemy team constantly is able to just get free damage even though were clearly canceling their charges but because they have 2-3 people just spamming abilities dealing chip damage they can get through it no matter what. 


This game really has potential to be a great moba, they could remove the helper system and add wards, they could add actual minion waves instead of the very gimmicky zeno thing and it could be an actual good MOBA but as of right now the game is too simple and too easily abusable for actual MOBA players like myself to enjoy and the game is too complex and too hard for the average dragon ball fan to understand. 

With all of this being said i still oppose the overhaul they're planning. Turning this game into a marvel rivals/overwatch clone is just a disservice to the fans of this game and those who spent money on it.
